summary: Manage organization auth (MANAGE_ORGANIZATION_AUTH) controls whether org admins can create and manage users and teams; it moves to gateway in a 2.4 to 2.6 upgrade but is not synced with controller, so keep both consistent. Other settings include stream idle timeout and max stream duration for the Lightspeed chatbot and the AAP deployment type.
questions: How do I stop organization admins from creating users?
Is MANAGE_ORGANIZATION_AUTH synced between gateway and controller?
How do I set the stream timeout for Lightspeed chatbot?
